//: Copy to alerts.json (gitignored - a webhook URL is a credential) and edit. Rules fire to `notify` targets: console, desktop, webhook, hub, command. Alerts are also published to alert.<name>, so they appear in the viewers beside the events that caused them.

rules.//: Anything bad from production. cooldown stops one broken service filling your notification centre.
rules.name: production errors

rules.//: Not any one error - a burst of them. This is what a deploy going wrong looks like.
rules.name: error spike

rules.//: The one most tools miss: a stream that STOPPED. A server with nothing to say and a server that is gone look identical until you check.
rules.name: handset went quiet

rules.//: Disk and certificates: the outages you can see coming.
rules.name: host trouble

rules.//: Anything that reads on a domain's control plane. NS and CAA changes are how a domain gets taken.
rules.name: dns changed

rules.//: Business-specific: match text rather than level. `command` receives SUPERLOG_ALERT_TITLE and SUPERLOG_ALERT_BODY in its environment - never interpolated into a shell string.
rules.name: payments failing
